knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The lesson says the owner buys the walk outcome and the certainty of getting it. Your hourly rate, kit list and years of walking are inputs, not what the owner buys.
The lesson says a guarantee must be something you can deliver and afford. Unlimited, impossible or narrowly restricted guarantees are not sound.
The lesson says a measured claim, such as a calmer dog after a set number of walks, must be backed by measurement. A brand endorsement, a discount or no evidence do not support a claim.

practicalCriteria: Applies the step to a real or simulated business decision and records the outcome

stopWorkCriteria: Not applicable: business guidance; stop if an offer would make an unsubstantiated or misleading claim
